top_signals.title: Illycaffe CEO on Coffee Prices, US Market, IPO Prospects
top_signals.summary: Illycaffe CEO Cristina Scocchia discusses coffee prices and possible growth opportunities for the company. Speaking on Bloomberg Television, Scocchia also says an initial public offering for the coffee roaster remains a "strategic opportunity," but the economic environment is not the right one. "When the market conditions will improve, we will re-evaluate all the options including the IPO and we will decide if, when, and where to list the company," Scocchia tells Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua. (Source: Bloomberg)
